content.text:
The drawing shows tetryl: a benzene ring carrying three nitro groups and an N-methyl-N-nitroamino group.

- **Ring:** six carbons with alternating double bonds.
- **Ring substituents:** the carbon at the upper right bears the N(CH3)NO2 group. The adjacent ring carbons at the top and bottom each bear a nitro group. The carbon at the lower left, para to the amino-bearing carbon, also bears a nitro group. This gives 2,4,6-trinitro substitution relative to the amino carbon.
- **Nitro groups:** each is drawn in charge-separated form, [N+](=O)[O-].
- **Side chain:** the exocyclic nitrogen carries a methyl group and a nitro group, so it is N(C)[N+](=O)[O-].

SMILES: CN([N+](=O)[O-])c1c([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1[N+](=O)[O-]
